verdict: The app does NOT share the research scatter's coordinate-pair collapse - it draws from a mulberry32 stream, not from two CRC32s over near-identical addresses. It has a DIFFERENT and unrelated gap: driftSpot applies no containment test of any kind, so roughly one placement in nine lands outside the parcel whose status tinted it. Its heavy clumping is DELIBERATE - the drift beds are an owner-directed 2026-07-18 refinement and the docstring says so - but that decision was taken for long grass, which is being withdrawn, and a bed that reads as massed grass reads as a blob when it is made of shrubs.
